validation_name: PPKG vs Alex - IIM Hospital Claim Search (Dev vs QAE)
//identifier_column: The hospital feature names its response files by the claim number: '<testcase>_<reqClmNbr>_*.json' (see alex_qae_hospital.feature / ppkg_dev_hospital.feature -> 'def claimIdentifier = row.reqClmNbr'). The engine already defaults the response-file key to the claim number (reqClmNbr), so NO identifier_column override is needed. Setting it to reqInvnCtlNbr made the engine look for '<testcase>_<reqInvnCtlNbr>_*.json', which does not exist, so every row was wrongly reported as RESPONSE_MISSING_BOTH. Left blank on purpose.
